author: blu
body: NOTE (compiler): byte conversion is local (str-bytes-loop), not WebServer's text-to-bytes. Passing an empty-list literal [] as an argument to a cross-chapter function call currently poisons bare-metal type inference (bogus "List vs Fun" in NetworkStack). Local helpers sidestep it.

author: blu
body: Salt is derived deterministically from the account id (v1: no stored salt field, no CSPRNG). A durable store with per-account random salt is a follow-up.
